newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel prices strong in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel prices strong in thin trade.

text.p: European straight-run fuel oil prices were confirmed in their recovery by a late Friday cargo deal, traders said.
A British refiner sold 25,000 tonnes of good quality 0.4 percent sulphur straight-run to a Scandinavian buyer for close to $101 fob.
Although the material attracted a quality premium, traders said the price was healthy.
Other sellers pegged their offers around the $100 mark in response though dealers valued the market at $96/$98 with little material prompt to sell.
Trade on Monday was very quiet. Russian straight-run cargoes were visible in the Baltics and the Black Sea with prices in line with those of last week.
The spring flood of Russian material has not yet materialised, traders added.
